WITH args AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text),'') AS email,
         NULLIF(btrim($2::text),'') AS full_name,
         NULLIF(btrim($3::text),'') AS phone
), f AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.name, c.email, c.phone
    FROM customers c, args a
   WHERE c.company_id = 1
     AND ( (a.email IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(a.email))
        OR (a.full_name IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(a.full_name)) )
   ORDER BY (a.email IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(a.email)) DESC
   LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO customers (name, email, phone)
  SELECT a.full_name, a.email, a.phone FROM args a
   WHERE a.email IS NOT NULL AND a.full_name IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f)
  RETURNING id, name, email, phone
)
SELECT 'FOUND'::text AS outcome, f.id, f.name, f.email, f.phone,
       (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM args a WHERE a.email IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(f.email) = LOWER(a.email))) AS by_email
  FROM f
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CREATED', ins.id, ins.name, ins.email, ins.phone, false FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MISSING_INFO', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, false
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM f)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
LIMIT 1;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text),'') AS customer_ref,
         NULLIF(btrim($2::text),'') AS title,
         NULLIF(btrim($3::text),'') AS site
), c AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM customers c, args a
   WHERE c.company_id = 1 AND a.customer_ref IS NOT NULL
     AND (c.id::text = a.customer_ref OR LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(a.customer_ref))
   LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO projects (customer_id, title, site_address)
  SELECT c.id, a.title, COALESCE(a.site, a.title) FROM c, args a
   WHERE a.title IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id, customer_id, title
)
SELECT 'CREATED'::text AS outcome, ins.id AS project_id, ins.title,
       c.name AS customer_name
  FROM ins JOIN c ON c.id = ins.customer_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND', NULL, NULL, NULL
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MISSING_TITLE', NULL, NULL, NULL
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM c)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
LIMIT 1;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text),'') AS project_ref,
         NULLIF(btrim($2::text),'') AS division_code,
         NULLIF(btrim($3::text),'') AS scope_description,
         COALESCE($4::numeric,0) AS labor,
         COALESCE($5::numeric,0) AS material,
         COALESCE($6::int,1) AS revision,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($7::text),''),'CREATED') AS status,
         btrim($8::text) AS raw_valid
), p AS (
  SELECT id, title FROM projects pr, args a
   WHERE pr.company_id = 1 AND pr.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.project_ref IS NOT NULL
     AND (pr.id::text = a.project_ref OR LOWER(pr.title) LIKE LOWER('%'||a.project_ref||'%'))
   ORDER BY (pr.id::text = a.project_ref) DESC
   LIMIT 1
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO estimates (project_id, division_code, scope_description, allocated_amount,
                         revision, status, valid_until)
  SELECT p.id, COALESCE(a.division_code,'Base Scope'), a.scope_description,
         a.labor + a.material, a.revision, a.status,
         CASE WHEN a.raw_valid ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN a.raw_valid::date END
    FROM p, args a
   WHERE a.scope_description IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id, project_id, allocated_amount
)
SELECT 'CREATED'::text AS outcome, ins.id AS estimate_id, p.title AS project_title,
       ins.allocated_amount
  FROM ins JOIN p ON p.id = ins.project_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PROJECT_NOT_FOUND', NULL, NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM p)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MISSING_SCOPE', NULL, NULL, NULL
 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM p) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
LIMIT 1;

WITH proj AS (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE (id::text = $1 OR LOWER(title) LIKE LOWER('%' || $1 || '%')) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND baseline_status = 'APPROVED' LIMIT 1) INSERT INTO change_orders (project_id, change_order_number, description, cost_impact, schedule_impact_days, reason, approval_status, tool_call_id) SELECT p.id, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(co.change_order_number) FROM change_orders co WHERE co.project_id = p.id), 0) + 1, $2, $3, $4, $6, 'PENDING', $5 FROM proj p ON CONFLICT (tool_call_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, change_order_number;

WITH w AS (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE lower(name) = lower($2) OR worker_code = $2 OR id::text = $2 LIMIT 1) INSERT INTO timesheets (project_id, worker_id, hours_worked, overtime_hours, work_description, date_worked, tool_call_id) SELECT $1, w.id, $3, $4, $5, CURRENT_DATE, $6 FROM w ON CONFLICT (tool_call_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id;

WITH proj AS (
  SELECT p.* FROM projects p
  WHERE (p.id::text = $1 OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || $1 || '%'))
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1
), cp AS (
  SELECT cp.* FROM company_profile cp JOIN proj ON proj.company_id = cp.id
), seq AS (
  UPDATE company_profile SET invoice_last_number = invoice_last_number + 1
   WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM cp) RETURNING invoice_last_number
)
INSERT INTO invoices (company_id, project_id, invoice_number, invoice_type,
                      net_amount, gst_amount, pst_amount, pst_applicable,
                      amount_due, holdback_amount, description, billing_percentage,
                      billed_basis, status, issued_date, due_date)
SELECT cp.id, proj.id,
       cp.invoice_prefix || LPAD(seq.invoice_last_number::text, 4, '0'),
       $2,
       ROUND(proj.original_contract_value * ($3 / 100.0), 2),
       ROUND(proj.original_contract_value * ($3 / 100.0) * cp.gst_rate, 2),
       CASE WHEN $4 THEN ROUND(proj.original_contract_value * ($3 / 100.0) * cp.pst_rate, 2) ELSE 0.00 END,
       $4,
       ROUND(proj.original_contract_value * ($3 / 100.0) * (1 + cp.gst_rate + CASE WHEN $4 THEN cp.pst_rate ELSE 0 END), 2),
       CASE WHEN $2 = 'FINAL' THEN 0.00
            ELSE ROUND(ROUND(proj.original_contract_value * ($3 / 100.0), 2) * cp.retention_rate, 2) END,
       NULLIF(btrim($5), ''),
       $3, ROUND(proj.original_contract_value, 2),
       'DRAFT', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + cp.invoice_due_days * INTERVAL '1 day'
FROM proj, cp, seq
WHERE proj.id IS NOT NULL
  AND $3 <= 100 - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(billing_percentage) FROM invoices
                            WHERE project_id = proj.id AND status <> 'DRAFT'
                              AND invoice_type IN ('DEPOSIT','PROGRESS_BILLING','FINAL')
                              AND billing_percentage IS NOT NULL), 0)
RETURNING id, invoice_number, invoice_type, net_amount, gst_amount, pst_amount, amount_due, holdback_amount, billing_percentage, billed_basis;

SELECT * FROM view_project_financial_summary WHERE (project_id::text = $1 OR LOWER(project_name) LIKE LOWER($2))
   AND project_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 1;

SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_type, i.net_amount, i.gst_amount, i.pst_amount,
       i.amount_due, i.holdback_amount, i.description, i.status, i.email_sent_at,
       i.issued_date, i.due_date, i.company_id, i.billing_percentage, i.billed_basis,
       p.original_contract_value AS contract_original,
       (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('description', li.description, 'amount', li.amount)
                                 ORDER BY li.created_at), '[]'::json)
        FROM invoice_line_items li WHERE li.invoice_id = i.id) AS lines,
       p.title AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, c.company_name AS customer_company,
       c.id AS customer_id, c.email, c.phone AS customer_phone,
       c.street_address AS bill_street, c.city AS bill_city, c.province AS bill_province,
       c.postal_code AS bill_postal,
       cp.company_name, cp.email_from_name, cp.email_from, cp.street_address, cp.city,
       cp.province, cp.postal_code, cp.phone, cp.signature_name, cp.brand_primary_color,
       cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url,
       cp.gst_reg_number, cp.pst_reg_number, cp.payment_instructions, cp.retention_rate, cp.logo_data, cp.logo_content_type,
       dt.html AS invoice_template_html
FROM invoices i
JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = p.company_id
LEFT JOIN document_templates dt ON dt.key = cp.invoice_template_key AND dt.is_active
WHERE i.id::text = $1 OR i.invoice_number = $1
LIMIT 1;

WITH base AS (SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS ref),
proj AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.title, p.baseline_status, p.baseline_approved_by, p.baseline_approved_at,
         p.baseline_approval_token
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN projects p
      ON (p.id::text = b.ref OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || b.ref || '%'))
      AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
   ORDER BY (p.id::text = b.ref) DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE projects p
     SET baseline_status = 'SENT',
         baseline_approval_token = gen_random_uuid()
    FROM proj
   WHERE p.id = proj.id
     AND p.baseline_status IN ('CREATED','REJECTED')
  RETURNING p.id, p.title, p.baseline_approval_token AS approval_token, p.baseline_status
)
SELECT COALESCE(u.id, p.id) AS id,
       COALESCE(u.title, p.title) AS title,
       CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL OR p.baseline_status = 'APPROVED' THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(u.approval_token, p.baseline_approval_token) END AS approval_token,
       COALESCE(u.baseline_status, p.baseline_status) AS baseline_status,
       p.baseline_approved_by, p.baseline_approved_at,
       (p.baseline_status = 'APPROVED') AS already_approved
  FROM proj p LEFT JOIN upd u ON u.id = p.id;

WITH base AS (SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS ref)
SELECT co.id, co.change_order_number, co.approval_token,
       p.title AS project_name, co.description
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN projects p ON (p.id::text = b.ref OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || b.ref || '%')) AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN change_orders co ON co.project_id = p.id AND co.change_order_number = (CASE WHEN btrim($2) ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN btrim($2)::int ELSE NULLIF(regexp_replace(btrim($2), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::int END)
WHERE b.ref IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1;

WITH base AS (SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS ref)
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.baseline_status, p.baseline_approved_by, p.baseline_approved_at,
       p.baseline_approval_token AS token, c.name AS customer_name, c.email,
       cp.company_name, cp.email_from_name, cp.brand_primary_color,
       cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url,
       (p.id IS NOT NULL) AS found,
       COALESCE(btrim(c.email), '') <> '' AS has_email,
       (p.baseline_status IN ('CREATED','SENT','REJECTED')) AS sendable,
       CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_FOUND'
            WHEN COALESCE(btrim(c.email),'') = '' THEN 'NO_EMAIL'
            WHEN p.baseline_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 'ALREADY_APPROVED'
            ELSE NULL END AS block_reason
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN projects p
    ON (p.id::text = b.ref OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || b.ref || '%'))
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = p.company_id
 ORDER BY (p.id::text = b.ref) DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 1;

SELECT co.id, p.id AS project_id, co.change_order_number, co.description, co.cost_impact, co.approval_token AS token, p.title AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, c.email, cp.company_name, cp.email_from_name, cp.brand_primary_color, cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url FROM change_orders co JOIN projects p ON p.id = co.project_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id CROSS JOIN company_profile cp WHERE cp.id = 1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (p.id::text = $1 OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || $1 || '%')) AND co.change_order_number = $2 LIMIT 1;

WITH inv AS (SELECT id FROM invoices WHERE invoice_number = $1 OR id::text = $1 LIMIT 1) INSERT INTO payments (invoice_id, payment_date, amount, method, notes, tool_call_id) SELECT inv.id, COALESCE($3::date, CURRENT_DATE), $2, $4, $5, $6 FROM inv ON CONFLICT (tool_call_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING invoice_id;

WITH vp AS (SELECT total_paid, balance_due, due_date FROM view_invoice_payments WHERE invoice_id = $1), upd AS (UPDATE invoices i SET status = CASE WHEN i.status = 'DRAFT' THEN i.status WHEN vp.total_paid = 0 THEN CASE WHEN vp.due_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'UNPAID' END WHEN vp.balance_due <= 0 THEN 'PAID' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END FROM vp WHERE i.id = $1 RETURNING i.invoice_number, i.status) SELECT upd.invoice_number, upd.status, vp.total_paid, vp.balance_due FROM upd CROSS JOIN vp;
SELECT * FROM fn_run_payroll($1::date, $2::int);
SELECT * FROM view_payroll_summary WHERE ($1::date IS NULL OR period_end = $1::date) ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO workers (worker_code, name, trade, hourly_rate, overtime_rate) SELECT COALESCE($1, (SELECT 'W-' || LPAD((COALESCE(MAX(SUBSTRING(worker_code FROM '([0-9]+)')::int), 0) + 1)::text, 3, '0') FROM workers WHERE worker_code ~ '^W-[0-9]+$')), $2, $3, $4, $5 ON CONFLICT (company_id, worker_code) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, trade = EXCLUDED.trade, hourly_rate = EXCLUDED.hourly_rate, overtime_rate = EXCLUDED.overtime_rate RETURNING id, worker_code, name, trade, hourly_rate, overtime_rate;
SELECT * FROM view_project_financial_summary WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR project_id::text = $1 OR LOWER(project_name) LIKE LOWER('%' || $1 || '%'));

SELECT * FROM view_project_financial_summary WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR LOWER(project_status) = LOWER($1))
     AND project_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY project_name;

SELECT i.invoice_number, p.title AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, i.amount_due, vp.total_paid, vp.balance_due, i.due_date, i.status FROM invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id JOIN view_invoice_payments vp ON vp.invoice_id = i.id WHERE ($1::text IS NULL OR LOWER(i.status) = LOWER($1)) ORDER BY i.due_date DESC;
SELECT * FROM view_schedule WHERE status <> 'DONE' AND (due_date IS NULL OR due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + ($1::int || ' days')::interval) ORDER BY due_date NULLS LAST, due_time NULLS LAST;
UPDATE company_profile SET briefing_time = $1::time WHERE id = 1 RETURNING briefing_time;
SELECT token FROM device_tokens UNION ALL SELECT NULL::text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens);

SELECT cp.company_name,
       cp.pm_name,
       cp.pm_preferred_name,
       (cp.setup_completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS setup_completed,
       COALESCE(cp.invoice_template_key, 'classic') AS invoice_template,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM workers WHERE active) AS worker_count
  FROM company_profile cp WHERE id = 1;

WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT lower(btrim(w.name)) AS name_key, btrim(w.name) AS name,
         nullif(btrim(w.trade), '') AS trade,
         nullif(w.hourly_rate, '')::numeric AS hourly_rate
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS w(name text, trade text, hourly_rate text)
),
upserted AS (
  UPDATE workers w
     SET trade = i.trade,
         hourly_rate = COALESCE(i.hourly_rate, w.hourly_rate),
         active = TRUE
    FROM incoming i
   WHERE lower(w.name) = i.name_key
  RETURNING w.id
),
added AS (
  INSERT INTO workers (name, trade, hourly_rate, worker_code)
  SELECT i.name, i.trade, i.hourly_rate,
         'W-' || lpad((b.max_code + row_number() OVER ())::text, 3, '0')
    FROM incoming i
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(max(NULLIF(regexp_replace(worker_code, '\D', '', 'g'), '')::int), 0) AS max_code
                  FROM workers) b
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workers w WHERE lower(w.name) = i.name_key)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM incoming) AS requested,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted) AS updated,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM added)    AS added,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM workers WHERE active) AS total_workers;

UPDATE company_profile
   SET company_name       = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, ''), company_name),
       pm_name            = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), pm_name),
       pm_preferred_name  = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), pm_preferred_name),
       street_address     = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), street_address),
       city               = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), city),
       province           = COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), province),
       postal_code        = COALESCE(NULLIF($7, ''), postal_code),
       gst_reg_number     = COALESCE(NULLIF($8, ''), gst_reg_number),
       pst_reg_number     = COALESCE(NULLIF($9, ''), pst_reg_number),
       payment_instructions = COALESCE(NULLIF($10, ''), payment_instructions),
       invoice_template_key = CASE
         WHEN NULLIF(btrim($11), '') IS NULL THEN invoice_template_key
         WHEN btrim($11) = 'classic' THEN NULL
         WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_templates t
                      WHERE t.key = btrim($11) AND t.is_active) THEN btrim($11)
         ELSE invoice_template_key END,
       setup_completed_at = COALESCE(setup_completed_at, now()),
       updated_at         = now()
 WHERE id = 1
RETURNING company_name, pm_name, pm_preferred_name,
          COALESCE(invoice_template_key, 'classic') AS invoice_template,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM workers WHERE active) AS worker_count;

parameters.query: UPDATE invoices SET last_client_html = $2 WHERE id::text = $1 RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO invoice_email_log (invoice_id, company_id, kind, recipient, message_id)
SELECT i.id, i.company_id, 'preview', cp.email_from, $1
FROM invoices i JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = i.company_id
WHERE i.id::text = $2 RETURNING id;

WITH valid AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim($2::text), '') AS email
   WHERE $2 IS NULL OR btrim($2::text) ~ '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
), upd AS (
  UPDATE customers c
     SET email          = COALESCE(v.email, c.email),
         phone          = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($3), ''), c.phone),
         street_address = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($4), ''), c.street_address),
         city           = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($5), ''), c.city),
         province       = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($6), ''), c.province),
         postal_code    = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($7), ''), c.postal_code)
    FROM valid v
   WHERE c.id::text = $1 OR LOWER(c.name) = LOWER(btrim($1::text))
  RETURNING c.id, c.name, c.email, c.phone, c.street_address, c.city, c.province, c.postal_code
)
SELECT 'OK'::text AS outcome, u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone,
       u.street_address, u.city, u.province, u.postal_code FROM upd u
UNION ALL SELECT 'INVALID_EMAIL', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
          WHERE $2 IS NOT NULL AND btrim($2::text) <> ''
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)
UNION ALL SELECT 'NOT_FOUND', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
          WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)
            AND NOT ($2 IS NOT NULL AND btrim($2::text) <> ''
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid))
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE company_profile
   SET gst_reg_number      = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($1), ''), gst_reg_number),
       pst_reg_number      = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($2), ''), pst_reg_number),
       payment_instructions = COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim($3), ''), payment_instructions),
       updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $4
RETURNING id, gst_reg_number, pst_reg_number, payment_instructions;

WITH proj AS (
  SELECT p.* FROM projects p
  WHERE (p.id::text = $1 OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || $1 || '%'))
    AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1
), cp AS (
  SELECT cp.* FROM company_profile cp JOIN proj ON proj.company_id = cp.id
), seq AS (
  UPDATE company_profile SET invoice_last_number = invoice_last_number + 1
   WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM cp) RETURNING invoice_last_number
), unbilled AS (
  SELECT co.id, co.change_order_number, co.description AS co_desc, co.cost_impact
  FROM change_orders co
  JOIN proj ON proj.id = co.project_id
  WHERE co.approval_status = 'APPROVED'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_line_items li
                    JOIN invoices i ON i.id = li.invoice_id
                    WHERE li.source_type = 'change_order' AND li.source_id = co.id
                      AND i.status <> 'DRAFT')
), net AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost_impact), 0) AS n FROM unbilled
), hdr AS (
  INSERT INTO invoices (company_id, project_id, invoice_number, invoice_type,
                        net_amount, gst_amount, pst_amount, pst_applicable,
                        amount_due, holdback_amount, description, billing_percentage,
                        billed_basis, status, issued_date, due_date)
  SELECT cp.id, proj.id, cp.invoice_prefix || LPAD(seq.invoice_last_number::text, 4, '0'),
         'CHANGE_ORDER',
         ROUND(net.n, 2), ROUND(net.n * cp.gst_rate, 2),
         CASE WHEN $2 THEN ROUND(net.n * cp.pst_rate, 2) ELSE 0.00 END, $2,
         ROUND(net.n * (1 + cp.gst_rate + CASE WHEN $2 THEN cp.pst_rate ELSE 0 END), 2),
         ROUND(net.n * cp.retention_rate, 2), NULLIF(btrim($3), ''), NULL, ROUND(net.n, 2),
         'DRAFT', CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE + cp.invoice_due_days * INTERVAL '1 day'
  FROM proj, cp, seq, net
  WHERE proj.id IS NOT NULL AND net.n > 0
  RETURNING id, invoice_number, invoice_type, net_amount, gst_amount, pst_amount,
            amount_due, holdback_amount, billed_basis
), lines AS (
  INSERT INTO invoice_line_items (invoice_id, source_type, source_id, description, amount)
  SELECT h.id, 'change_order', u.id,
         'Change order #' || u.change_order_number
           || COALESCE(' - ' || NULLIF(btrim(u.co_desc), ''), ''),
         u.cost_impact
  FROM unbilled u JOIN hdr h ON true
  RETURNING source_id
)
SELECT h.id, h.invoice_number, h.invoice_type, h.net_amount, h.gst_amount,
       h.pst_amount, h.amount_due, h.holdback_amount,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lines) AS line_count
FROM hdr h;

WITH base AS (SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS ref),
j AS (
  SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.company_id, i.invoice_number, i.amount_due, i.net_amount, i.gst_amount, i.pst_amount,
         i.holdback_amount, i.status, i.issued_date, i.due_date,
         c.name AS customer_name, c.company_name AS customer_company, c.email AS customer_email,
         p.title AS project_name,
         cp.company_name AS our_name, cp.street_address, cp.city, cp.province, cp.postal_code,
         cp.phone AS our_phone, cp.email_from, cp.email_from_name, cp.gst_reg_number, cp.pst_reg_number,
         cp.website, cp.signature_name, cp.payment_instructions,
         vp.total_paid, vp.balance_due,
         (c.email IS NOT NULL AND btrim(c.email) <> '') AS has_email,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments pay WHERE pay.invoice_id = i.id) AS has_payments
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_number = b.ref OR i.id::text = b.ref
  LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = i.company_id
  LEFT JOIN view_invoice_payments vp ON vp.invoice_id = i.id
  WHERE b.ref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT j.*,
       (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('payment_date', pay.payment_date, 'amount', pay.amount, 'method', pay.method)
                        ORDER BY pay.payment_date, pay.created_at)
        FROM payments pay WHERE pay.invoice_id = j.invoice_id) AS payments,
       (SELECT pay.amount FROM payments pay WHERE pay.invoice_id = j.invoice_id ORDER BY pay.payment_date DESC, pay.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_amount,
       (SELECT pay.method FROM payments pay WHERE pay.invoice_id = j.invoice_id ORDER BY pay.payment_date DESC, pay.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_method,
       (SELECT pay.payment_date FROM payments pay WHERE pay.invoice_id = j.invoice_id ORDER BY pay.payment_date DESC, pay.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_date,
       (j.has_email AND j.has_payments) AS sendable
FROM j;

INSERT INTO invoice_email_log (invoice_id, company_id, kind, recipient, message_id)
SELECT $2::uuid, $3::smallint, 'receipt', $4, $1
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices WHERE id = $2::uuid)
RETURNING id;
SELECT token FROM device_tokens UNION ALL SELECT NULL::text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens);

SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_type, i.net_amount, i.gst_amount, i.pst_amount,
       i.amount_due, i.holdback_amount, i.description, i.status, i.email_sent_at,
       i.issued_date, i.due_date, i.company_id, i.billing_percentage, i.billed_basis,
       p.original_contract_value AS contract_original,
       (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object('description', li.description, 'amount', li.amount)
                                 ORDER BY li.created_at), '[]'::json)
        FROM invoice_line_items li WHERE li.invoice_id = i.id) AS lines,
       p.title AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, c.company_name AS customer_company,
       c.id AS customer_id, c.email, c.phone AS customer_phone,
       c.street_address AS bill_street, c.city AS bill_city, c.province AS bill_province,
       c.postal_code AS bill_postal,
       cp.company_name, cp.email_from_name, cp.email_from, cp.street_address, cp.city,
       cp.province, cp.postal_code, cp.phone, cp.signature_name, cp.brand_primary_color,
       cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url,
       cp.gst_reg_number, cp.pst_reg_number, cp.payment_instructions, cp.retention_rate, cp.logo_data, cp.logo_content_type,
       dt.html AS invoice_template_html
FROM invoices i
JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = p.company_id
LEFT JOIN document_templates dt ON dt.key = cp.invoice_template_key AND dt.is_active
WHERE i.id::text = $1 OR i.invoice_number = $1
LIMIT 1;
UPDATE invoices SET last_client_html = $2 WHERE id::text = $1 RETURNING id;
SELECT token FROM device_tokens UNION ALL SELECT NULL::text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens);
SELECT id, name, email, phone FROM customers WHERE company_id = 1 ORDER BY name;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO approval_log (company_id, project_id, kind, recipient, message_id)
  SELECT cp.id, p.id, $1, $2, $3
    FROM projects p JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = p.company_id
   WHERE p.id::text = $4 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
   RETURNING id
), fl AS (
  UPDATE projects p SET baseline_status = 'SENT'
   WHERE p.id::text = $4 AND p.baseline_status IN ('CREATED','SENT','REJECTED')
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT ins.id AS log_id, fl.id AS project_id FROM ins JOIN fl ON fl.id::text = $4;

INSERT INTO approval_log (company_id, project_id, kind, recipient, message_id)
SELECT cp.id, p.id, $1, $2, $3
  FROM projects p JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = p.company_id
 WHERE p.id::text = $4 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id;

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.title, c.name AS customer_name, p.baseline_status,
         p.baseline_approved_at, p.baseline_approved_by,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM estimates e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) AS est_count,
         (SELECT COALESCE(sum(allocated_amount), 0) FROM estimates e WHERE e.project_id = p.id) AS est_total,
         al.kind AS last_kind, al.created_at AS last_at
    FROM projects p
    JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT kind, created_at FROM approval_log
      WHERE project_id = p.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) al ON true
   WHERE p.company_id = 1
     AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND ($1::text IS NULL OR p.id::text = $1 OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || $1 || '%'))
     AND ($2::text IS NULL OR LOWER(p.baseline_status) = LOWER($2))
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT b.title AS project_name, b.customer_name, b.baseline_status,
         b.baseline_approved_at, b.baseline_approved_by,
         b.est_count, b.est_total, b.last_kind, b.last_at
    FROM base b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base)
) t ORDER BY t.project_name NULLS LAST;

WITH rot AS (
  UPDATE projects p
     SET baseline_approval_token = gen_random_uuid()
    FROM customers c, company_profile cp
   WHERE p.id::text = $1
     AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND c.id = p.customer_id
     AND cp.id = p.company_id
     AND p.baseline_status IN ('CREATED','SENT','REJECTED')
  RETURNING p.id, p.title, p.baseline_approval_token AS token, p.baseline_status,
            c.name AS customer_name, c.email,
            cp.company_name, cp.email_from_name, cp.brand_primary_color,
            cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url
)
SELECT * FROM rot;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '') AS ref,
         COALESCE($2::boolean, false) AS do_it
), r AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.title
    FROM projects p, args a
   WHERE a.ref IS NOT NULL
     AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND p.company_id = 1
     AND (p.id::text = a.ref OR LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || a.ref || '%'))
   ORDER BY (p.id::text = a.ref) DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1
), d AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.title,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM invoices i WHERE i.project_id = r.id) AS invoice_count,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM estimates e WHERE e.project_id = r.id) AS estimate_count,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM change_orders co WHERE co.project_id = r.id) AS change_order_count
    FROM r
), upd AS (
  UPDATE projects p
     SET deleted_at = now()
    FROM d, args a
   WHERE p.id = d.id AND a.do_it AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  RETURNING p.id, p.title
)
SELECT CASE
         WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_FOUND'
         WHEN upd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'REMOVED'
         ELSE 'NEEDS_CONFIRMATION'
       END AS outcome,
       d.title,
       COALESCE(d.invoice_count, 0) AS invoices,
       COALESCE(d.estimate_count, 0) AS estimates,
       COALESCE(d.change_order_count, 0) AS change_orders
  FROM (SELECT 1) one
  LEFT JOIN d ON true
  LEFT JOIN upd ON upd.id = d.id;

SELECT COALESCE(cp.invoice_template_key, 'classic') AS current_key,
       (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('key', t.key, 'name', t.display_name,
                        'description', t.description) ORDER BY t.key)
          FROM document_templates t WHERE t.is_active) AS templates,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM device_tokens) AS device_count
  FROM company_profile cp
 WHERE cp.id = 1;
SELECT token FROM device_tokens UNION ALL SELECT NULL::text WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_tokens);

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE company_profile cp
     SET invoice_template_key = CASE WHEN btrim($1) = 'classic' THEN NULL ELSE btrim($1) END,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE cp.id = 1
     AND (btrim($1) = 'classic' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_templates t
                                             WHERE t.key = btrim($1) AND t.is_active))
  RETURNING COALESCE(cp.invoice_template_key, 'classic') AS template
)
SELECT 'UPDATED' AS outcome, upd.template FROM upd
UNION ALL
SELECT 'INVALID_TEMPLATE', NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd);
